referenceFunction.generalComment: Average data for the operation of an light weight concept (650kg) battery electric vehicle. Electricity certified. Input and emission of refrigerant used for air conditioning was added by A.Messmer.; UUID: 5aa09d04-42df-36b1-8438-2d0251d81bdf
referenceFunction.includedProcesses: Energy consumption from certfied electricity is included. Emissions of particulate matters and heavy metals are accounted for, unless of combustion origin. Particulate emissions comprise abrasions emissions only. Heavy metal emissions to soil and water caused by tyre abrasion are included. Real consumption surplus of 70% added. AM 22.7.2016
